steps.content: Has the illusion captured you? You see the Nightmare roaring near behind you, the energy it shoots out obliterating one of the Misery Puppet's arms.
Just as you want to turn back to take another look, a huge shadow suddenly lands right above your head, and you hear a loud roar.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, you f***ing idiot!
And then you get smashed by the girl who's suddenly appeared and fallen down. You see stars.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Why can't you just mind your own business?! I see you've gotten beaten up again! I can handle this way better than a weakling like you, why can't you just patiently wait for me to come back?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I thought you were going to die...!
Hella isn't listening to you at all. She throws herself around your neck and begins yelling and crying.

Is this the side effect of the Fear illusory realm? She can't control her emotions at all, almost having a breakdown at this supposedly touching reunion. You can only act calm and pat her on the back of her head.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: There, there, I'm still alive. I'm fine.

steps.content: The other person comes near you from behind, stooping down beside you.
Hecate touches your wounds with a hand, her lips twitching slightly, as if having difficulty finding the right words to say.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: In the end, you guys had to come and save me, thank you.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: No, it's not like that... You saved me...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The fight hasn't ended yet. This time, I won't let you get hurt again.
The Misery Puppet's arm has slowly grown back.

steps.speaker: Misery Puppet
steps.content: Dance... Our Dancer... Give us love and redemption... Dance for us...

Behind the three puppets, Hamel's dance seems to have entered the climatic finale. As if confronting the contamination, she raises her arms, and they get pressed down heavily. She raises them again, and they get pressed down again.
The illusory realm of the park is no longer able to resist the contamination. She's also suffering immense pain herself, yet the healing illusory realm is still holding up everything on the lake.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It's that Sinner's ability. Is she Hamel? She's indeed a terrifying enemy.
But it should end now. The stage has already been corrupted by the contamination, and it may devour her at any moment too.

On the lakeside, more men in black raincoats are emerging. They're shouting bizarre words you can't comprehend, transforming into black flames and spreading into the three puppets' bodies through the lake. They're now completely contaminated.

steps.speaker: Void, Fear & Misery
steps.content: Don't disturb... Don't damage... our Carnival, our revelries...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Humph, how stupid, a bunch of cowards. I'm not scared of you anymore.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Give me your order, Chief. I won't run away anymore.
Then, go back to your original purpose. The Black Ring has given you nightmare. You didn't come here to escape from it, but to face it and defeat it.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Let it all come to an end. I'm going to the real Black Ring!
